businesses.business: specialty retail of body care and home fragrance

offering_description.value: Specialty retailer of body care, fragrance and home fragrance products sold to individual consumers through its own stores, website and franchise partners. Designs its own brands and sells products made by outside manufacturers.

primary_products.value: body care; fragrance mists; hand soaps and sanitizers; candles; home fragrance

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying personal care and home fragrance products

end_markets.value: personal care; home fragrance; specialty retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: body care, fragrance and home products sold in stores, online and through franchise partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets own-brand products made by outside manufacturers, sold to consumers; retailer: sells products to consumers through company stores, website and franchise partner stores

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada company stores, Puerto Rico, plus international franchise partners

specialization.value: related lines: body care, fragrance mists, candles and home fragrance sold to the same consumers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated retail stores across North America; online: company website and mobile app; partners / resellers: franchise partners operating stores in other countries

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cosmetic product safety and labeling rules under FDA and consumer protection laws
